newsitem.title: USA: TWA may get Russian partner - USA Today.
newsitem.headline: TWA may get Russian partner - USA Today.

text.p: A New Jersey investment group whose partner includes Russian airline Transaero has proposed a deal to take control of Trans World Airlines Inc, USA Today said Thursday.
The paper said representatives from Strategic Capital Group, led by investor Brian Freeman, presented their plan to TWA at the carrier's Tuesday board meeting.
The paper said Freeman declined comment, but quoted the vice chairman of the Russian airline as saying he is looking at making TWA a strategic partner and using it as a U.S. feeder.
